en: Changed the default OpenTelemetry `service.name` of desktop Code tab sessions to `claude-code-desktop`; update filters keyed on `claude-code`, or set `OTEL_SERVICE_NAME` to keep the old name
zh: 将桌面版 Code 标签页 session 的默认 OpenTelemetry `service.name` 改为 `claude-code-desktop`；请更新以 `claude-code` 为键的过滤条件，或设置 `OTEL_SERVICE_NAME` 以保留旧名称
